notes.title: Trick or Treat Adventure: Combinations
notes.content: [p]Weekly [url="https://trickortreatadventure.com/"][u][b]Trick or Treat Adventure[/b][/u][/url] for Steam update time![/p][p][/p][p](don't forget to [url="https://trickortreatadventure.com/"][u][b]wishlist![/b][/u][/url])[/p][p][/p][p]✅ Add "quality of life/user experience" enhancements (pathfinding, bug fixes, menu stuff, etc.)[/p][p]✅ Get it working on Windows, Mac, Linux, and Steam Deck[/p][p]❓New content ???[/p][p][/p][p]We've turned a corner on development and are working on adding NEW content to the game! (You thought you could keep the developers of [url="https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/587787"][u][b]Abobo's Big Adventure[/b][/u][/url] from scope creeping???)[/p][p][/p][p]The first item of business is making "combining inventory items" more exciting. We're hoping this feels special for the player (an encouraging reward/payoff for solving puzzles) and provides some nice visuals for an upcoming new video trailer.[/p][p][/p][p]Check it out![/p][p][/p][p]My programmer placeholder art:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45705236/d144fb54b53a7bc61a89807d6e5f20415fa3bf14.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Poxpower's animated updated hotness:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45705236/0baf0e49fbebd218f4e322db2b2163654edd536c.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Currently, there are around a dozen different inventory item combos you can do... that might grow though![/p][p][/p][p]We have some cool ideas for more [b]new[/b] content too![/p][p][/p][p]Come back next week to see what the next big idea is![/p][p]Any guesses?[/p][p][/p][p]And once again... [url="https://trickortreatadventure.com/"][u][b]WISHLIST ON STEAM![/b][/u][/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for dropping by![/p][p][/p][p]--Nick[/p]

notes.title: Trick-Or-Treat Adventure Coming To Steam This October!
notes.content: [p]Are you ready to point-and-click your way through a ridiculous, spooky, pixelated adventure? You better be, because our retro-style [b]Trick-Or-Treat Adventure[/b] game is coming to Steam October 1st, 2025![/p][p][/p][p]Trick-or-Treat Adventure hearkens back to the the classic adventure games we grew up on from the likes of LucasArts and Sierra back in the day. You'll take control of Little Johnny, a neglected outcast who simply wants to slap together a cheap, makeshift Halloween costume out of household items so he can go trick-or-treating in his neighborhood. But trick-or-treating in this twisted town isn't as simple as ringing a doorbell and asking for candy.[/p][p][/p][p]No, you have to [b]earn[/b] your candy here. What does that mean? Maybe you'll have to sacrifice an innocent... maybe you'll have to venture into the sewers... maybe you'll have to battle the forces of darkness. But hey... it's all worth it because... CANDY![/p][p][/p][p]We've made a boatload of upgrades including improved pathfinding, an updated script, and many more unique interactions! The game features numerous Steam achievements, cloud saves, and will be available for PC, Mac, & Linux players![/p][p][/p][p]Add the game to your Wishlist and mark your calendars for October 1st so you can be among the first to go on a [b]Trick-Or-Treat Adventure![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45705236/3f298702a8dbe78b4fa5e72408997b124733e3c7.png"][/img][/p]
